content:
anya: quick heads-up — ran a cross-region latency/throughput sweep for redwood-instruct-3b (q4f) across A100/H100 in us-east/us-west/eu-west. us-west p95 is much worse than expected.
ben: can you paste the numbers?
anya: pasted below (raw):
```
# A100, q4f, seq512, batch1
us-east  p50: 42ms  p95: 95ms  tps: 68 tok/s
us-west  p50: 45ms  p95: 260ms tps: 65 tok/s
eu-west  p50: 40ms  p95: 85ms  tps: 69 tok/s

# H100, q4f, seq512, batch1
us-east  p50: 28ms  p95: 70ms  tps: 120 tok/s
us-west  p50: 30ms  p95: 210ms tps: 110 tok/s
eu-west  p50: 26ms  p95: 68ms  tps: 125 tok/s
```
anya: notice the p95 gap in us-west for both A100 and H100. p50s are fine.
mohit: interesting — any kernel diffs or fallback logs?
anya: saw a bunch of kernel fallbacks on the A100 us-west hosts:
```
2026-09-12T14:12:03Z kernel-manager INFO selecting kernel flash_attn_v2 for model redwood-instruct-3b
2026-09-12T14:12:04Z kernel-manager WARN flash_attn_v2 failed, falling back to unfused_attention
2026-09-12T14:12:04Z perf WARN high variance detected in kv-cache warmup (cold miss)
```
sara: could this be edge routing adding hops causing jitter?
anya: yes — infra logs show many requests to the us-west fleet were routed via the central pop in us-east for a subset of clients. route traces: `eu-west-pop2 -> us-east-pop1 -> us-west-pop1` for some sticky routes.
perf-bot: summary: p95 inflation correlated with cross-pop routing and kernel fallback frequency. p95 delta ~+150ms when route includes extra hop.
carmen: capacity-wise what does this imply? any sizing recs?
anya: rough calc: to keep p95 under 100ms in us-west, either add ~20% extra reserved heads (handles bursts + warmup) OR force local-pop routing for the bursty customer tier + enable aggressive KV pre-warm.
mohit: actionables: 1) I'll dig into why flash_attn_v2 falls back — maybe driver mismatch or cudnn patch. 2) sara, can you trial a routing policy that prefers local-pop for the Canary group?
sara: yes — I can flip a routing flag for 5% of traffic tomorrow morning and measure.
carmen: i'll update capacity calc and pricing impact if we need +20% reserved.
ben: any quick mitigation we can push today?
anya: short-term: enable unfused attention cache warmup (reduce cold miss), set routing hint to prefer same-region, and add a per-pop extra small buffer of instances for 2 hours during ramp. low-risk.
infra-bot: deploy request queued: routing-hint toggle -> canary (5% traffic) by sara. runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/edge-routing-test
mohit: also check kernel flags: `--enable-flash-attn-v2` vs `--force-unfused`. I'll post findings.
anya: noted. let's reconvene after the canary run (sara) and kernel check (mohit). If canary reduces p95 by >100ms we can roll more broadly. cc @carmen for capacity updates. :thumbsup:
